LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 2.1.1 LISTENING FOR COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension, part of Strand 2 in Grade 8 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: how to describe actions in future tense, 1. How do we listen to acquire information?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm the uses and dangers of the internet with peers,

2. list on separate charts the advantages and disadvantages of the internet and display in class,

3. listen to a passage on the proper use of the internet and take notes,

4. discuss the do’s and don’ts of the use of the internet with peers,

5. create a glossary of new words related to the theme from the text listened to,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm the uses and dangers of the internet with peers,
2. list on separate charts the advantages and disadvantages of the internet and display in class,
3. listen to a passage on the proper use of the internet and take notes,
4. discuss the do’s and don’ts of the use of the internet with peers,
5. create a glossary of new words related to the theme from the text listened to,
6. conduct a discussion on

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is enhanced as the learner brainstorms the uses and dangers of the internet with peers.

• Communication and Collaboration: The learner works jointly with peers to discuss the do’s and don’ts of the use of the

internet.

Values:
• Responsibility: This is nurtured as the learner diligently lists on separate charts the advantages and disadvantages of the

internet and displays in class

• Integrity: This is exercised as the learner works with peers to make sentences related to the theme with verbs in their future

tense.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social Cohesion: This is promoted as the learner collaborates with peers to discuss the do’s and don’ts of using the internet.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept on netiquette and proper use of the internet with similar concepts in technology use in

Pre-Technical Studies.
